subject: How can I install package "RAmazonS3" from repos?

messages.author: d036473709cadea0
messages.subject: How can I install package "RAmazonS3" from repos?
parts:
The question comes from the article "Share data across sessions with shinyapps.io".


Package RAmazonS3 is needed if we want to save or read file from Amazon S3 server. However, I failed to install the package from any of the 3 repositories (CRAN, GitHub and BioConductor) which are required if we want to deploy the app to shinyapps.io.

Below are the details:

Firstly, I tried below command:
install.packages("RAmazonS3", repos = "http://www.omegahat.org/R")

Below error was hit:
package ‘RAmazonS3’ is available as a source package but not as a binary
Warning in install.packages : package ‘RAmazonS3’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)

Then, I tried to install it from github by using below command:
install_github('duncantl/RAmazonS3')

Then saw another error: 
Downloading github repo duncantl/RAmazonS3@master
Installing RAmazonS3
"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-30~1.2/bin/i386/R" --vanilla CMD INSTALL \
"C:/Users/jiang_y/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpA5uKQ8/devtools12387514781/duncantl-RAmazonS3-3032bf7" --library="C:/Program \
Files/R/R-3.0.2/library" --install-tests

* installing *source* package 'RAmazonS3' ...
**********************************************
WARNING: this package has a configure script
It probably needs manual configuration
**********************************************
** libs
*** arch - i386
make: curl-config: Command not found
make: curl-config: Command not found
make: curl-config: Command not found
make: curl-config: Command not found
C:\Rtools\gcc-4.6.3\bin\nm.exe: sign.o: File format not recognized
gcc -m32 -shared -s -static-libgcc -o RAmazonS3.dll tmp.def sign.o -Ld:/RCompile/CRANpkg/extralibs64/local/lib/i386 -Ld:/RCompile/CRANpkg/extralibs64/local/lib -LC:/PROGRA~1/R/R-30~1.2/bin/i386 -lR
sign.o: file not recognized: File format not recognized
collect2: ld returned 1 exit status
ERROR: compilation failed for package 'RAmazonS3'
* removing 'C:/Program Files/R/R-3.0.2/library/RAmazonS3'
* restoring previous 'C:/Program Files/R/R-3.0.2/library/RAmazonS3'
Error: Command failed (1)

 I can download the "RAmazonS3_0.1-5.tar.gz" and install it successfully from local file. However, I can not deploy my app to shinyapps.io since it requires the package to be installed from repos ( CRAN, BioConductor and GitHub ).

Does any have suggestions? Thank you.
